name: How long does the typical multifamily property purchase process take?

mainEntity.name: How long does the typical multifamily property purchase process take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical multifamily property purchase process can range from 30 to 90 days, depending on factors like financing approval, property inspections, and the complexity of negotiations. Cash transactions can close faster, while those involving commercial loans may take longer due to more extensive due diligence. A process clarity insight is that environmental assessments and in-depth financial reviews of existing leases and operating expenses are common, which can extend timelines. Kelby Contreras guides buyers through each stage, helping manage expectations and coordinating with all parties to keep the process on track, whether in Miami or Fort Lauderdale.
acceptedAnswer.description: The purchase process typically takes 30-90 days, influenced by financing and due diligence. Environmental assessments and financial reviews can extend timelines, requiring careful management.
